name: calclink-native
description: CalcLink native layer: flat C ABI over tilibs (libticables2, libticalcs2, libtifiles2, libticonv). Dependency list copied from tilibs' own vcpkg.json at 6dba390e, except USB: CalcLink builds tilibs' libusb-1.0 backend on Windows (patches/tilibs-0001-windows-libusb-1.0-backend.patch), so calculators use the WinUSB driver instead of libusb-win32.
